simple.meaning: תְּשׁוּעָה (tᵉshûwʻâh) is a Hebrew action word meaning “rescue (literal or figurative, persons, national or spiritual).” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 34 times in Judges, 1 Samuel, 2 Samuel, 2 Kings, 1 Chronicles, and 6 more, beginning at Judges 15:18. The surrounding contexts include blood, city, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תְּשׁוּעָה (H8668) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: תְּשׁוּעָה (tᵉshûwʻâh) / H8668 is traced through Judges 15:18, 1 Samuel 11:9, 1 Samuel 11:13, 1 Samuel 19:5 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.short: rescue (literal or figurative, persons, national or spiritual)
definitions.full: H8668. teshuah תְּשׁוּעָה ( תְּשֻׁעָה 2Sam 19:3 ) noun feminine deliverance, salvation = יְשׁוּעָה (formed by false analogue, as if from √ שׁוע , in sense of ישׁע ; most assign it to שׁוע , but no sufficient evidence for existence of such a √; compare Kö ii. 200 ) — absolute ׳ת 1Sam 11:9 19t.; construct Jer 3:23 5 t.; suffix תְּשׁוּעָתִי Isa 46:13 2 t.; תְּשׁוּעָֽתְךָ Psa 40:11 2 t.; תְּשׁוּעָתֶ֑ךָ 40:17 ; 71:15 ; — 1 deliverance , usually by God, through human agency, especially from oppression 1Sam 11:9 , and in battle 1Chr 19:12 ( הוֺשׁיע in || clause), = victory Judg 15:18 ( ת ׳נָתַתָּ וגו ׳בְּיַד ), 2Kin 5:1 , ת ׳עשׂה ׳י 1Sam 11:13 ׳י wrought a great victory , so 19:5 ; 2Sam 19:3 ; 23:10 , 12 ; 1Chr 11:14 (as accusative of congnate meaning with verb after הושׁיע ), Prov 21:31 ; Psa 33:17 ( נושׁע in || 33:16 ); ת ׳הַנּוֺתֵן למלכים 144:10 ; so in phrase ׳חֵץתֿ ליהוה 2Kin 13:17 , ׳חֵץתֿ בַּאֲרָם 13:17 ; of national deliverance , from exile, ת יִשְׂרָאֵל ׳נוֺשַׁע עולמים Isa 45:17 (Da Synt.:§ 67 b ), 46:13 (|| צְדָקָה ), 46:13 (with נתן ; || תִּפְאֶרֶת ); in General of national success and prosperity Jer 3:23 ; Prov 11:14 = 24:6 ; of deliverance from personal trouble Psa 37:39 ; Lam 3:26 ( י ׳תְּשׁוּעַת ) or of national deliverance under figure of personal Psa 40:11 (|| אֱמוּנָָֽתְךָ ), 40:17 ; 71:15 (|| צְדָקָח ), so ׳י תְּשׁוּעָתִי Psalm 38:23; contrasted with ׳י s deliverance is אָדָם תְּשׁוּעַת deliverance of (through) man Psalm 60:13 = 108:13 , compare 146:3 . 2 more exclusively spiritual in sense , = salvation , appear to be תְשׁוּעָתִי אֱלֹהֵי Psa 51:16 ; 119:41 (|| חֲסָדֶךָ ), Psalm 51:81, and ת יִלְבְּשׁוּ ׳כֹּהֲנֶיךָ 2Chr 6:41 (from יֵשַׁע אלברשׁ כהניה Psa 132:16 ).
